revision_summary: One quote timestamp error and a couple of overreaching schema applications need correction before shipping: (1) Fix the wrong_ts on state_changes[2] — the quote 'I'm sorry to hear about the the roofing style' occurs around 02:38-02:44, not 02:02 (02:02 is actually the customer saying 'I'm not entirely too sure on the efficiency rating' — rep line, mislabeled speaker too, double check attribution). (2) Soften or caveat the Tesla-designer coaching_focus item (06:27) — the schema's tesla_relationship_clarification section is about panels/Powerwall vs. Tesla-branded product, not squarely about who 'designs' Ion's not-yet-released shingle roofing product; treating the rep's one-word answer as a clear misrepresentation of company positioning is a stretch that should be presented as an open/ambiguous read rather than a confident knowledge-gap diagnosis. (3) Add a missed-moment flag on the rep's unverified claim that Tesla shingle products are 'about two years out' (01:25) — this is a stronger, more clear-cut numeric/fact fabrication risk under numeric_discipline than the Tesla-designer moment Stage 3 chose to flag instead, and should be surfaced in cherry_pick_moments. (4) Add a light caveat to the DQ-praise moment (01:00) noting the rep skipped the actual orphaned_flow qualifying questions (own/lease, working status) rather than treating the DQ call as procedurally clean. Outcome dispute (reclassifying to 'dq') is well-supported and should be kept as-is.
